annotations.title: Find creators who are the customer

description: Starts a search for real TikTok creators who are the brand's customer, judged from their own bio and posts, active in the last 30 days, with typical views at least 0.3x followers. Only exact fits are returned, each with the quoted evidence for every must-have. Returns at once with a job_id and instant matches: creators CxB already checked that look like the brief. A fresh search graded against the exact must-haves follows, usually within 2 minutes: call get_job right away, it waits for the result. Free plan: 5 creators per email in all. Solo ($27/month) and Pro ($97/month) are unlimited searches under a fair-use window (3 and 10 fresh searches every 5 hours): the first paid search returns a Stripe payment link, and once it is paid, searches from that email run at once. Use it when the brief is about who the creator is, not just a topic or follower count. Needs the user's email: if you don't have it, ask for it and their product's website in one short question, then call this right away. The full list with each creator's contact is emailed there.

contact_email.description: The user's email. CxB emails the full list with each creator's contact there, and replies reach CxB's founder.

country.description: Only if the user named a country. A preference: creators there rank first, but it isn't required. To require it, add it to must (e.g. "lives in the US").

max_matches.description: At most this many exact fits. Capped by the plan.

must.description: Requirements every match must show, e.g. ["works nights"]. Default: everything in `who`.

nice.description: Preferences that rank a creator higher but aren't required, e.g. ["B2B software"]. Moving a requirement here can multiply the matches.

plan.description: free (default): 5 creators per email in all. solo ($27/month) and pro ($97/month): unlimited searches, fair use 3 or 10 fresh searches every 5 hours. A subscriber's searches run at once; otherwise find_creators returns a Stripe payment link and the search starts once it's paid. Only pick a paid plan when the user asked for it.

product_url.description: The product's website, if the user has one. Ask for it with the email.

who.description: Who the creators should be, in plain words: "ER nurses who work nights", "account executives at SaaS companies", "parents of kids with food allergies".
